main_text.head: In duplices Apostatas, id est, repetitos Romanos Pseudocatholicos.

p.i: AD nostros Romā Cahierus senerat olim,

l.i: A nostris Romam nunc, Cahiere, redis.
Sic vomitum canis, & repetit lutum amica sus:
At tu, quo fiunt porcique canésque magistro,
Christi habita sancto de grege nuper ones,
Quum bis Romanus sic fiat Apostata duplex,
Pœna & par sceleri debeat esse suo,
Et noua fabrorum tibi turba accesserit, illa
Perfida sub Iesu nomine tecta cohors,
Perge, Satan, donec damnato structa labore,
Sint bis Romanis tartara bina tuis:
Scilicet vt, Romam porcis canibúsque fugatis,

main_text.head: In IOANNEM MALDONA-tum Hispanum, insignem factionis Sacrosanctum Iesu nomen mentitæ Sophistam.

p.i: QVum mala tam multis, male Maldonate, daturum

l.i: Offensi in tertas mitteret ira Dei.

page.notes: Large decorative initials A (line 1 of first poem) and Q (second poem) are set as drop capitals. Some words are blurred or show-through; the wording of the scan was followed as closely as legible. Catchword "Téque" is set at the foot of the page.
